ItemID: NA; Title: Time; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to explore it this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ryan Adams; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy songwriting appeals to me, but I would pass this time and focus on blues.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This seems close to the soulful sound I enjoyed on Memphis, though I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Old Sock, I would gladly try more of Clapton's relaxed, bluesy playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Johnny Winter's guitar blues fits my interest in Hendrix and would be my other pick today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Revelator; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues and soulful guitar work fit my listening, but I am only choosing a couple of albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rhythm & Blues; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Buddy Guy's blues fits my current interests, though Step Back gets my attention first.
ItemID: NA; Title: New; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues guitar today than a pop-oriented album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Slipstream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Bonnie Raitt's soulful vocals and slide guitar appeal to me, but I would leave this for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The singer-songwriter direction fits my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but it is not my first choice today.
